title: One Month Into Developing Overdrive: My Transformers Inspired Wave Survival Game
author: ProfMags
selftext:
Hello! First time posting here :)

I’ve been working on a game called **Overdrive** for about a little over a month now. It’s heavily inspired by the Escalation mode from *Transformers: War for Cybertron*, which was always one of my favorite parts of that game.

Overdrive is an infinite wave-based survival game focused around fast-paced combat, transforming between robot and vehicle forms, and having a movement system that’s just genuinely fun to mess around with. I’ve been putting a lot of time into things like wall running, wall jumping, sliding, dodging, boosting, vehicle movement, transformations, abilities, different enemy types, and gradually making the waves more difficult as you survive longer.

This is still a **very early build**, so there are definitely a lot of bugs, unfinished systems, placeholder animations, rough VFX, balancing issues, and other things that still need a ton of work. I’m constantly changing and improving things as I go, but even in its current state I’ve honestly been having a blast playing it.

I’ve also been using **GPT-6 and Opus 5.5** to help me with development, especially when it comes to models, animations, textures, and other assets because those are definitely not my strong suit. A lot of the actual gameplay mechanics, ideas, balancing, systems, and overall direction are things I’ve been working on and designing myself.

It’s been really fun seeing everything slowly come together, especially considering I only started working on it around a month ago. There’s still a huge amount I want to add and improve, but I’m genuinely really proud of what I’ve managed to pull off so far.

I’d love to hear what you guys think! Any feedback, criticism, suggestions, or ideas for things you think could be improved would be really appreciated. :)
